description: Track US dollar funding stress and money markets around the world with Seiche's free public data. Get a daily 0-100 funding-stress reading and briefing, stress readings for 40 money markets, official ECB and Federal Reserve exchange rates and their history, central bank rates and government bond yields for over 30 countries, currency and commodity pressure, and over 100 downloadable time series from oil prices to Treasury yields. Every value carries its own date and official source. No account or API key required.
